messages:
elaine: Quick alignment request 1: we need a short playbook for customer-facing follow-ups after postmortems: what we publish automatically vs on-request, redaction rules, and an escalation loop for recurring failures. I sketched a draft below.

mike: thanks. prefer short bullets so on-call can copy/paste. also need legal + sales-safe phrasing.

elaine: draft decision rules: 1) Auto-publish within 24h: Public summary (one para, non-technical). 2) Publish technical addendum within 72h by default for any incident with customer impact >5% or >1 hour. 3) Full RCA package (detailed timeline, logs, mitigations) only on customer request or for severity P1/P0. Redaction: remove customer-identifying data unless customer explicitly asks.

sam: +1. For "technical addendum" include: sequence, impact measured, immediate mitigations, and whether recurrence check flagged. Keep it concise (1-2 pages).

lina: Recurrence detection: if similarity signature hits >=2 incidents in 45 days OR >=4 in 180 days, mark as "recurring pattern" and escalate to a "Pattern Review" (eng + SRE + PM + security). We should *always* note recurrence in the addendum with an owner and target ETA.

jen: Can we get exact wording for customers when it's a recurring pattern? Sales will want to avoid alarmist language. Maybe: "We have observed instances with similar root causes; were treating this as a high priority and have a remediation owner and timeline."

mike: neutral + action-oriented works. Legal wants no speculation about liability. Avoid words like "systemic failure" unless validated.

elaine: OK suggested template snippets below for on-call:
```Public summary (paste): We experienced a service disruption affecting <product area> beginning <time>. Service restoration: <time>. Impact: <brief>. Next steps: We will publish a technical addendum within 72 hours. If you would like the full investigation package, request via support@redwood.example.```
```Technical addendum (paste): 1) Timeline: <hh:mm> 2) Root cause (summary): <short> 3) Immediate mitigations: <actions> 4) Impact quant: <metric> 5) Recurrence status: <no pattern / pattern detected - owner + ETA>```

sam: Where to land templates: incidents/docs/customer-templates.md and add a PR template that checks items: legal review required?, redact PII?, attach metric screenshots?

elaine: Action items (owners + unix deadlines):
- jen: Post public summary within 24h (owner: jen, due_ts: 2412370800)
- sam + eng-lead: Draft technical addendum within 72h (owner: sam, due_ts: 2412536799)
- mike: Coordinate intake form + approvals for full-package requests (owner: mike, due_ts: 2412450000)
- lina: Finalize recurrence thresholds and similarity signature with eng-ml (owner: lina, due_ts: 2412372000)
- tara: Add templates + checklist to incidents repo and update on-call runbook (owner: tara, due_ts: 2412375000)

lina: I'll need access to historical incident tags to tune the signature. tagging rule: error-code + service + stacktrace hash + time window. Eng-ml will provide a similarity scoring function.

mike: incident-bot, can we auto-add a "recurrence-review" label to threads that meet threshold and notify eng-leads?

incident-bot: I can. Will run a nightly job that computes similarity across incidents using tags and will post in-thread when thresholds are exceeded. Need eng-ml scoring endpoint and permission to label threads.

jen: On the public summary: keep it apology-free but customer-first. Example: "We restored service at T. Customers may have experienced X. We're publishing more details and next steps." No internal ticket numbers.

elaine: Also add a one-line SLA-credit escalation path: if customer impacted > X% of requests for > Y minutes then ops escalates to finance & sales for credit evaluation. Mike, can you draft thresholds?

mike: I'll propose thresholds by EOD.

tara: small UX ask: include a direct link in the status page post to the technical addendum PR so customers who want more context can find it. status page supports a "details" link.

elaine: Good call. Add to template: "More details: <link to technical addendum or PR>"

sam: I'll create the action tracker entries now and @-mention owners.

jen: Posting public summary now and will attach link.

incident-bot: Public summary posted to status page at 2412370500 (https://status.redwood.example/incident/2412369999)

mike: Received. Will follow up on SLA-credit thresholds and intake flows.

elaine: Thanks all. If no objections I'll convert these to the formal incident-comms SOP and close loop. :thumbsup: 

lina: No objections from me.

sam: Same.

jen: all good.
